candidates.violated_requirement: After matching the first three bits (011) of the sequence, a fourth bit of 1 should transition to s5 (next correct state), but instead transitions to sf5 (failure path) due to the swapped ternary operands. This causes the sequence 011100 to be incorrectly classified as not_match.
candidates.spec_basis: The module must detect the sequence 011100 from the input signal data. If the sequence is not detected in a group, the not_match output should assert.
